name: How long does it take to repair a rotten door jamb?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a rotten door jamb?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to repair a rotten door jamb depends on the extent of the damage and the complexity of the door frame. A minor repair might take a few hours, while a more extensive repair or partial replacement could take a full day. Factors like the type of wood, existing finishes, and whether the repair involves custom-matching elements can also influence the timeline. Our specialists at Maine Results, Inc. provide a time estimate after assessing the specific damage during an on-site visit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies based on damage extent and complexity, ranging from a few hours for minor issues to a full day for more extensive repairs or replacements.
